title: Burroughs suffers physical effects
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Burroughs suffers physical effects, about 1980 onward at Rendlesham Forest, England, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the other Witnesses John buroughs a US Air Force Airman also experienced physical and psychological effects

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Burroughs, a US Air Force airman who was one of the witnesses to strange events in Rendlesham Forest in England in 1980, suffered physical and psychological effects afterward. If true, it would suggest that whatever the witnesses encountered there could harm the people near it.
